statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-39883 affects the BSD kenv command invocation in OpenTelemetry's host resource detection. The kenv command is specific to FreeBSD/macOS and does not exist on Linux. The dhi/build image runs exclusively in Linux containers, so the vulnerable code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-39883 affects go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk@1.40.0 embedded in the etcd binary, which is an upstream artifact included from dhi/etcd. Bumping otel/sdk to v1.43.0 in the etcd image definition is required. Waiting for the etcd image to be rebuilt with the fix.
